newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: Mob attacks El Salvador prison, four inmates escape.
newsitem.headline: Mob attacks El Salvador prison, four inmates escape.

text.p: Four inmates escaped from the main city jail on Friday as a mob armed with guns and grenades attacked guards from outside the prison, attempting to provoke a mass breakout, authorities said.
Between 20 and 30 armed men attacked La Esperanza jail just north of the capital in the early morning hours, injuring one prison officer, jail director Nicolas Campos told reporters.
"Fortunately, we are lamenting the escape of only four who took advantage of the gunfire and grenade attack launched by unknown people," he said.
Three brothers, jailed for kidnapping, were among those who escaped. The fourth was a convicted robber.
La Esperanza houses 2,000 inmates, and during this Central American country's civil in the 1980s was attacked on numerous occasions by guerrillas attempting to free detained comrades.
